Hi Luke and Madhan, your Ramsey validation result looks promising; please share the final repository and submission reference before the cutoff.
Please include the exact weighted graph/counts, proof or certificate, reproduction steps, paper and a short novelty note.
What is still unfinished or blocked? Let me know so I can help you get the review materials together.

Thanks, Chandragupt, the GitHub invitation has arrived; I’ll review the repository shortly.
Please include the exact decomposition, checker, paper and final submission reference, and confirm which commit we should judge.
I understand a few checks are still running; please flag their status and any specific proof or reproduction issue you would like guidance on.

Hi Raj, I found your public Kobon repository and will review the arrangements and partial upper-bound work shortly.
Please point me to the final commit, paper and submission reference, and distinguish proved restrictions from cases that remain open.
Include the exact checking/reproduction route and flag anything still incomplete or needing help.

Hi Tom, did you end up producing any work for OpenMath, individually or with a team?
If so, please send the repository and a brief summary of the finished result, proof/checker and submission status.
Useful partial results or formalizations are welcome to review too; please flag any submission blocker.

Hi Frederik, I found your K4 Ramsey and Heilbronn projects; please share the final repositories, papers and submission references for any results you want judged.
For each, separate finished proofs/certificates from search results, and explain the exact advance over the frozen reference or any useful formalization.
Please confirm the final commits and reproduction steps, and tell me if anything is still incomplete or blocked.
